# secureaccess_roaming_computer_web_security_override (Resource)

This resource manages Secure Web Gateway override settings of Roaming Computers.
 Roaming Computers are referenced by their origin ID. Only the listed Roaming Computers are managed, on destroy their override setting is removed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "secureaccess_roaming_computer_web_security_override" "example" {
  enabled_origin_ids  = [123456789]
  disabled_origin_ids = [987654321]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `disabled_origin_ids` (List of Number) The list of Roaming Computer origin IDs with Secure Web Gateway always disabled.
- `enabled_origin_ids` (List of Number) The list of Roaming Computer origin IDs with Secure Web Gateway always enabled.
